description: Aurora agent surface (minimal LLM cost — state transition, no re-planning). Only relevant when actively managing an Aurora agent. Reject a semi-automated agent that is waiting in pending_plan_approval or pending_action_approval. Mirrors POST /api/agent/:agentId/reject, marks the latest assistant message as errored, transitions through the state machine, traces the rejection, and publishes a websocket update.
name: reject_agent_action
